# `signal-graph` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "signal-graph" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/signal-graph/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (editor and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | What the mechanism does and how to solve it, for review. |
| `nodes` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Emitters, logic and receivers. |
| `nodes[].id` | id | required | Node id, unique in the graph; wires refer to it. |
| `nodes[].observed` | boolean | — | Outputs are read outside the graph (puzzle goal, quest), so unwired is fine. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"volume"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].shape` | object | required | Box, sphere or capsule, relative to the graph origin. |
| `nodes[].shape.kind` | `"box"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].shape.center` | object | required |  |
| `nodes[].shape.center.x` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.center.y` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.center.z` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.halfExtents` | object | required | Half the size per axis. |
| `nodes[].shape.halfExtents.x` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.halfExtents.y` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.halfExtents.z` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.kind` | `"sphere"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].shape.radius` | number ≥ 0 | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.kind` | `"capsule"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].shape.from` | object | required |  |
| `nodes[].shape.from.x` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.from.y` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.from.z` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.to` | object | required |  |
| `nodes[].shape.to.x` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.to.y` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].shape.to.z` | number | required | Metres. |
| `nodes[].filter` | list of object | — | Conditions an entity must all pass. |
| `nodes[].filter[].test` | `"property"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].filter[].property` | `"material"` \| `"temperature"` \| `"flammable"` \| `"ignitionPoint"` \| `"fuel"` \| `"burning"` \| `"wetness"` \| `"frozen"` \| `"freezePoint"` \| `"conductive"` \| `"charge"` \| `"weight"` \| `"fragile"` \| `"hp"` \| `"density"` \| `"climbable"` \| `"liftable"` \| `"pushable"` \| `"hideable"` \| `"reflective"` \| `"transparent"` \| `"opaque"` \| `"soundDamping"` \| `"friction"` \| `"impactAbsorb"` \| `"owner"` \| `"liquid"` \| `"flammableGas"` \| `"extinguishable"` \| `"waterSurface"` \| `"unstable"` \| `"suspended"` \| `"support"` \| `"breakable"` \| `"bashable"` \| `"cuttable"` \| `"shootable"` \| `"softAnchor"` \| `"surfaceHardness"` \| `"chargeActivated"` \| `"lightActivated"` \| `"hidden"` \| `"trapped"` \| `"trap"` \| `"container"` \| `"remains"` \| `"noiseMultiplier"` | required | World property to compare (absent = its default). |
| `nodes[].filter[].op` | `"eq"` \| `"ne"` \| `"lt"` \| `"lte"` \| `"gt"` \| `"gte"` | required | Comparison; lt/lte/gt/gte need a number property. |
| `nodes[].filter[].value` | number or boolean or string | required | Value to compare with. |
| `nodes[].filter[].test` | `"tag"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].filter[].tag` | id | required | Tag the entity must carry, e.g. "player". |
| `nodes[].filter[].test` | `"element"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].filter[].element` | `"fire"` \| `"water"` \| `"ice"` \| `"charge"` | required | fire = burning, water = wetness > 0, ice = frozen, charge = charge > 0. |
| `nodes[].minCount` | integer ≥ 1 | — | Occupants needed for `active`; default 1. |
| `nodes[].minWeight` | number ≥ 0 | — | Total occupant weight (kg) needed for `active`; default 0. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"lever"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].initial` | boolean | — | Starts on; default false. |
| `nodes[].entity` | id | — | Level entity id this node is bound to. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"button"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"sensor"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].entity` | id | required | Level entity id this node is bound to. |
| `nodes[].filter` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Conditions an entity must all pass. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"and"` \| `"or"` \| `"xor"` \| `"not"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"delay"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].seconds` | number > 0 | required | Seconds (rounded to whole ticks, at least one). |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"timer"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].retrigger` | boolean | — | A new edge restarts the timer; default true. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"pulse"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].edge` | `"rising"` \| `"falling"` \| `"both"` | — | Default rising. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"latch"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].initial` | boolean | — | Starts set; default false. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"counter"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].target` | integer ≥ 1 | required | Rising edges needed. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"sequence"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].steps` | list of id (at least 2) | required | Input port names in the expected order. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"random"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].outcomes` | list of id (at least 2) | required | Output port names, one pulsed per rising edge. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"receiver"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].receiver` | `"door"` \| `"light"` \| `"spawner"` \| `"audio-cue"` \| `"fact"` \| `"mechanism"` | required | What the signal drives. |
| `nodes[].entity` | id | — | Required by door, light, spawner and mechanism. |
| `nodes[].key` | string | — | Fact key or audio cue id (fact, audio-cue). |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"set-property"` | required |  |
| `nodes[].on` | object | required | Written when the input rises. |
| `nodes[].on.temperature` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Current temperature, °C. |
| `nodes[].on.flammable` | boolean | — | Fire can ignite it. |
| `nodes[].on.ignitionPoint` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Temperature at which it ignites, °C. |
| `nodes[].on.fuel` | number 0–86400 | — | Seconds of burning left. |
| `nodes[].on.burning` | boolean | — | On fire right now. |
| `nodes[].on.wetness` | number 0–1 | — | How soaked it is (dry … saturated), 0 … 1. |
| `nodes[].on.frozen` | boolean | — | Frozen solid. |
| `nodes[].on.freezePoint` | number -273.15–10000 | — | Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C. |
| `nodes[].on.conductive` | boolean | — | Conducts electric charge. |
| `nodes[].on.charge` | number 0–1000000 | — | Stored electric charge. |
| `nodes[].on.weight` | number 0–1000000 | — | Mass, kg. |
| `nodes[].on.fragile` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Impact energy that breaks it, J. |
| `nodes[].on.hp` | number 0–1000000 | — | Structural hit points. |
| `nodes[].on.density` | number 0.01–100000 | — | Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water. |
| `nodes[].on.climbable` | integer 1–3 | — | Climbing grade: 1 easy, 2 needs stamina, 3 needs skill or a tool. |
| `nodes[].on.liftable` | boolean | — | Can be picked up and carried. |
| `nodes[].on.pushable` | boolean | — | Can be pushed or dragged. |
| `nodes[].on.hideable` | boolean | — | An actor can hide in or behind it. |
| `nodes[].on.reflective` | boolean | — | Reflects light beams and bolts. |
| `nodes[].on.transparent` | boolean | — | Light and sight pass through it. |
| `nodes[].on.opaque` | boolean | — | Fully blocks light and sight. |
| `nodes[].on.lightEmitter` | object | — | Emits light. |
| `nodes[].on.lightEmitter.intensity` | number 0–100000 | required | Light output (a torch is about 100). |
| `nodes[].on.lightEmitter.radius` | number 0–100 | required | Reach, m. |
| `nodes[].on.soundDamping` | number 0–1 | — | Fraction of sound it absorbs, 0 … 1. |
| `nodes[].on.friction` | number 0–2 | — | Surface friction coefficient. |
| `nodes[].on.impactAbsorb` | number 0–1 | — | Fraction of impact energy it absorbs, 0 … 1. |
| `nodes[].on.owner` | id | — | Ownership tag (faction or owner id). |
| `nodes[].on.liquid` | boolean | — | A liquid: it pours, puddles and can have a water surface. |
| `nodes[].on.flammableGas` | boolean | — | A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it. |
| `nodes[].on.extinguishable` | boolean | — | A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out. |
| `nodes[].on.waterSurface` | boolean | — | Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice (needs a liquid material). |
| `nodes[].on.unstable` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it, J. |
| `nodes[].on.suspended` | boolean | — | Hangs from its support; falls when the support breaks, burns or is cut. |
| `nodes[].on.support` | integer ≥ 0 | — | Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns. |
| `nodes[].on.breakable` | boolean | — | A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it. |
| `nodes[].on.toughness` | object | — | Per kind of hit, the single-hit energy that breaks a breakable object; a kind left out never does. |
| `nodes[].on.toughness.blunt` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J. |
| `nodes[].on.toughness.slash` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Slash hit energy that breaks it, J. |
| `nodes[].on.toughness.pierce` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J. |
| `nodes[].on.toughness.force` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Force (blast, quake, boulder) energy that breaks it, J. |
| `nodes[].on.bashable` | boolean | — | A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable). |
| `nodes[].on.cuttable` | boolean | — | Slash or pierce damage severs it. |
| `nodes[].on.shootable` | number 0–1000000 | — | Projectile impulse that fires its signal, N·s. |
| `nodes[].on.softAnchor` | boolean | — | Rope arrows and hooks embed in it. |
| `nodes[].on.surfaceHardness` | `"soft"` \| `"medium"` \| `"hard"` | — | Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard). |
| `nodes[].on.chargeActivated` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Stored charge at which the mechanism fires. |
| `nodes[].on.lightActivated` | number 0–1000000000 | — | Light level on it at which the mechanism fires. |
| `nodes[].on.hidden` | boolean | — | Not perceivable or targetable until revealed. |
| `nodes[].on.trapped` | boolean | — | Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap). |
| `nodes[].on.trap` | id | — | Trap definition id a trapped object triggers. |
| `nodes[].on.container` | boolean | — | Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component). |
| `nodes[].on.remains` | boolean | — | Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise. |
| `nodes[].on.noiseMultiplier` | number 0.2–3 | — | Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's. |
